contexts.text: The eyes of Leah were weak () = ... that the affections of external truth are weak as to the understanding; or, what is the same, those who are in them... For general ideas which are not as yet illustrated by particulars are infirm and wavering. Described, Example(s).
Hence it is evident how weak in understanding are those who are solely in external truths.
They suppose (anxiety about spiritual things) to be a weakness and sickness of the lower mind.

To the merely natural; these appear weak and sick in spirit; but they are strong and mighty; while those who are merely natural appear to themselves strong and mighty... but are utterly feeble as to the spirit, because spiritually dead.
Joshua weakened Amalek () = a diminution of their power.
The pleasures of the appetites and of the body... debilitate the understanding...
These same (women) induced a weakness on the right eye; and this is why Leah is described as being weak in the eyes.
(Anxious thoughts about worldly matters) cause weaknesses of mind...
Zinzendorf was then as it were debilitated in mind... because his pride was lowered.
